entry.content: Hi! I’m pengi and this is my blog! I attempted to make this last summer but also got really lazy… Anyways I’ll probably write posts about things I’m learning about or find interesting in math or astronomy. I will hopefully try and write a post every few days but will probably run out of ideas very quickly so if you have any ideas, please let me know. Thanks!
